scope: Independent source review of SDK CLOCK macro/snapshot, external actor, unchanged production CLOCK accounting, native image helper, runner/oracle and final passport writer.
Source-bound protocol/evidence admission review only; no claim of actual guest execution, certification, cryptographic attestation or human review.
accepted_findings: Shared clock_abi macro preserves legacy output-discard behavior; snapshot names existing x0 through x3 and never exposes x4.
No production kernel implementation changes or test-specific corruption/probe hooks are introduced.
Actor performs three real CLOCK calls per envelope; mandatory oracle executes after the end snapshot in both modes; ON adds actor-private volatile recorder stores only.
Checked monotonic counters, stable nonzero frequency, zero READ_WINDOW differences and nonnegative residual are required; reports occur outside measured intervals.
Exact 64-word report, unique loader/report/completion, own root exit and complete reclamation are required by the host oracle.
Fixed three OFF/ON pairs per DEV/PROD profile retain attempted failures; no retry or historical sample reuse is introduced.
Passport writer checks immutable definition snapshots, actual declared QEMU/frequency/compiler/features and protocol/input/resource/contract/oracle pins.
Absent or stale source/negative-review evidence leaves SAR NOT_RUN and makes admission ineligible; producer execution success does not fabricate review PASS.
Bundle artifacts preserve exact ELF bytes, sources, logs, raw reports, protocol, environment and evidence; shared-image paths resolve under campaign root.
All six pair assessments are retained; failed structural admission returns an error and record_eligible remains false.
pending: Actual guest campaign and negative-test execution are separate required evidence, not assertions of this source review.
limits: Execution-window accounting is not exclusive CPU time; unattributed residual does not localize kernel or host delay.
Recorder comparison excludes full timestamp instrumentation cost; limited samples do not establish tails or performance superiority.
Reported incomplete query counts can be rejected; host evidence cannot detect an adversary forging the entire actor and custody chain.
